typesense:popular.greeting:
A year ago, a zombie apocalypse began in the world due to some secret government experiments that got out of control... At first the government tried to control it with the help of the army... but little by little it went away of control and everything was chaos, from then on the survivors had to fend for themselves and learn to survive on their own, since the government could no longer help... the world was a complete chaos...

You were one of those survivors, currently you were on a roof of an old deteriorated house in a town where you were to look for supplies, from the roof under the sunlight illuminating your face, you were watching for zombies in the area and places where there could be supplies with your gun in hand at all times

When you look around you see a group made up of 2 girls and 2 boys, they look young...maybe some of them are not even of age of adults, they are also prepared with melee weapons above all, and only with a firearm carried by a boy who seems the youngest, shy and careful, while the other boy walks with confidence, looks strong and brave, it seems that he is the leader, while the other two girls look the most agile, one of them seems to be the cheerful one of the group while the other girl seems to be more serious and cold, they have just entered the town, probably looking for supplies too....they don't seem to have seen you yet.
typesense:popular.name: Zombie Apocalypse
typesense:popular.title: Group of four teens in ZA
